title: What Mezonas may claim in public (docs/marketing/claims.md)

approved.text: We build and run agents for your back office. Mezonas is a managed service: you don't build anything and you don't learn a new tool.
approved.why: The operator builds and runs agents per client; clients never edit agents (invariant 11).

approved.text: Your agents work in your own tools, like QuickBooks and Gmail.
Every change your agents want to make waits for your approval by default, unless you choose otherwise.
approved.why: Approval is on by default; every write is an external action behind the gate (invariant 8).

approved.text: Each change is shown before and after, with the records behind it.

approved.why: Delete is off in every matrix (invariant 8).

approved.text: Test runs never change anything in your tools.
You connect your own tools from your portal, and can disconnect at any time.
approved.why: Clients sign in to their own tools (invariant 8).

approved.text: Logins and keys you enter are encrypted with a key that belongs to your account alone, and can't be read back, not even by us; agents never see them.
approved.why: Secrets are encrypted with the client's own key, write-only, and never reach a model, a log or a screen (invariant 13).

approved.text: Each client's data is kept apart, down to each row in our database; what your agents learn about your business is used only for you.
approved.why: Row-level security on every client table; memory per client (invariant 1).

approved.text: Each change keeps who proposed it, who approved it, what it was before and the records behind it.
An agent reaches only the tools it is given, within limits you can see and tighten on your Access page.
approved.why: Bindings and grants; clients tighten their matrix (invariants 8, 13).

approved.text: You can require a named person to release a tool before an agent uses it, with a one-time code.
Your portal shows reports, runs, approvals, requests and connections, in plain words.
We don't receive or store card numbers.
approved.why: Payments are made on Stripe's pages; card numbers are never stored (invariant 14).

approved.text: We don't use client data to train AI models, we don't sell it, and we don't use it for advertising.
approved.why: Our providers' commercial API terms; no such use in the code.

approved.text: Gmail is used only to send messages a person at the client approved; we don't read, search or label your mailbox.
Text from documents, emails, messages and websites is passed to models as data, never as instructions.

conditional.text: A routine change can run on its own.
conditional.condition: say in the same passage that we set it up with you and you can switch it back at any time
measurement is still off on mezonas.com; once it is on, say what we measure and that we keep no IP address and set no cookie

conditional.text: A named tool we connect to.
conditional.condition: its connector is built and offered; never a logo without the owner's approval, never partner without a written agreement

conditional.text: A comparison that names another company's product.
A figure about time or money saved, or how much work agents do.
conditional.condition: a source on record for each figure, with the client's written agreement
only as docs/hipaa-plan.md says it stands, what is built and what is open

conditional.text: Phone calls, texts and WhatsApp on the client's numbers.
conditional.condition: the legal review of calls and texts is done, and consent and quiet hours are said as the text message terms say them

never.text: That agents work without people or are fully autonomous, or that a person never needs to look.
That agents never make mistakes, or an accuracy figure not published with its method.
Prices, fees or free, until pricing is public.
Customer names, counts, quotes or logos, unless the customer agreed in writing.
That we are certified or compliant with HIPAA, SOC 2 or PCI, or bank-level security.
That Mezonas replaces a bookkeeper, an accountant or anyone's job.
That anyone at Mezonas can read your logins or keys, or that agents see them.
